paragraphs.text: The Clan Tree of Cridhe is a magical oak tree growing in the center of the mainland of the plane of Cridhe . It is thought to be as old as the plane itself. Considered the heart of the world, it holds the primary leyline of the plane. It controls the passage of the plane's seasons.

At the base of the Tree, an ancient stone holds two ornately carved messages from the Maker , the Blessing and the Curse. The Blessing, which faces the clan, reads "Keep me and I will keep you." On the other side, the Curse, facing the Tree, reads "He who harms me harms all the world. My wound shall be his wound, and the darkness of his wound shall not be taken from him, and shall mark his line unto its last generation." The Curse later fell on the line of Nohr .

Instigated by Malvos , the wizard Nohr destroyed the tree trying to become a planeswalker . When it was destroyed, the stability of the plane was violated. The ancient curse of the god who created this plane became true. The isle split in two, separating the Clan. Nohr and his descendants were cursed with madness.

As foretold by Haen , the Mending of the Clan Tree occurred when the lines of Haen and Nohr finally met. 520 years after the Parting, the Keeper Aylith used her powers to break the curse on Nazir . Together, they spoke the litany of light and recreated the Clan Tree of Cridhe from the last existing acorn.
The tree experiences intense mana showers.
